column3: “Wrapped in” renders “clothed with”; BSB has “legs” for πόδες (“feet”).
“Which lay open” renders ἠνεῳγμένον; “land” renders γῆς.
“Like the roar of a lion” recasts “as a lion roars.”
BSB follows the critical text with “had spoken” (no “their voices”) and no “to me.” “Put it in writing” renders “to write.”
BSB follows the critical text with “right hand.”
“Will be fulfilled” renders the aorist ἐτελέσθη (“was completed”).
BSB has “small scroll” where the critical text has βιβλίον (“scroll”); “small scroll” is the Textus Receptus word.
BSB has direct speech, “Give me the small scroll,” like the Textus Receptus; the critical text has δοῦναί (“saying to him to give me”).
BSB follows the critical text with “they told me.” BSB moves “many” to the front of the list.
